{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed orders in population)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove the 6 fake QA orders with revenue = '999999.99'
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Confirm the number of fake orders removed
fake_count = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Removed {fake_count} fake QA orders with revenue = '999999.99'.")

# Now check conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute difference
difference = email_rate - search_rate

print(f"Conversion rate (email): {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")

# Print final population size
print(f"Final population size: {df_clean.shape[0]} completed orders (after removing fake and refunded)")"}
